main_text.p: פָּקַק Obturare, Claudere. פָּקָּ Operculum. פָּקְפַּק Fodere; Scrutari; בּוּ מִפְקְפִין אֵין Non scrutantur, inquirunt in eam. פּוּקְפָּק Obturatio, impedimentum.

פָּקַד Præsumere: פּוֹקְרִים הַפִּינִים Præsumunt hæretici: מִפְקִיר אַפִּיקוּרוֹס Præsumptuosus. Deductum, ut Elias vult, ab Epicurus. הַפְּקִיר Liberum, commune facere, Proflituere: הַפְקִירָה עַצְמָהּ Proflituit seipsam, R.Salom. Genes. 38.14. & Gen. 24.16. הַפְּקֵר Liberum, commune: נְשֵׁי הַפּוּשִׁיִּים Uxores Aethiopum communes sunt, nec ullus vir novit, quis pater suus sit, Aben Esra Amos 9.7. Hinc & Lupanar Judæis vocatur הַפְּקֵר.
פְּרַגְמָטִיקוֹס Pragmaticus, πραγματικός Mercator, Negotiator, פְּרַגְמַטְיָא πραγματεία Negotiatio. Scribitur & פְּרַקְמָטְיָא.

פָּרַד Dividere; Separare; Disjungere. נִפְרָד Separatum, Abstractum, Absolutum, sive absoluta forma Nomen, cujus oppositum נִסְמָךְ Conjunctum, Constructum: מְלֵה מְגוּרְדָת Dictio collectiva, ut צֹאן Ovis, oves. הַנִּפְרָדִים שְׁכָלִים Intelligentiæ separatæ, abstractæ. פִּירוּד נִתְפַּרֵד Separatio. Separari: Separatum, Singulare fieri; In numerum singularem deduci, Aben Esra. Gen. 23.1.
פַּרְדְּסָאוֹת Custodes, vel; Custodia militum, 2.Reg.17: ab initio in Kimchi. Scribitur & פַּרְדְּסִיאוֹת in R.Sal. Vide & Hos.5. ab initio in Comm.
פַּרְכַּס Trepidare, Tremere, Movere se; Genes.25. v.22. in R.Salom.
פַּרְהֶסְיָא · פָּרַהְסִיא παρρησία, unde בְּפַרְהֶסְיָא Publice, Palam, Manifeste, Num.11.10. in Aben Esra. Oppositum ipsi בִּצְנְעָה Secreto, Occulte.
פְּרוֹזְדּוֹר · פְּרוֹזְדוֹר Vestibulum, Porticus: unde illud in Capitulis Patrum, הַתְּקֵן עַצְמְךָ בְּפְרוֹזְדּוֹר שֶׁתִּתְּכָנֵם לְטַרְקְלִין Præpa-ra te [?]

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Latin copied letter by letter from the scan; vowel points and some Hebrew/Greek letters are uncertain and not marked individually. The last line is cut off at the foot of the page; the Latin word "Præpa-" continues beyond the scan, so the end is marked [?]. The mark at top centre is a stray printer's mark and not transcribed. The entries are dictionary headwords with glosses; the line "פָּרַד ... Separatum" is the printed entry as read.
